label: Week 39, 2026
recap:
Week 39, 2026 was quiet, with two bill movements and one case update recorded, and no federal documents. The two bill movements reflected status changes, not final passage, and were split between California and the District of Columbia, one in each jurisdiction.

The bills touched three themes, each appearing once: health care, infrastructure and energy, and transparency and disclosure. The health care theme involved clinical decision support, utilization review, mental health chatbots, and AI in diagnosis or coverage decisions. The infrastructure and energy theme involved data centers and the power they draw, while transparency and disclosure covered labeling AI-generated output and impact assessments. No unthemed bills were recorded.
